about_the_game:
ZEROAD is an intense roguelite shooter where strength is forged on asphalt, and experience is the only currency you can't lose. Clear roads, kill zombies, earn XP, and upgrade your survivor, who grows stronger with every run. Find weapons, increase their rarity, and modify them with random affixes to craft a deadly combo for your next push.

Choose Your Road

After each road you clear, you choose the next one — one of three. You decide what lies ahead. What matters more: to try your luck hunting for a new gun, to attempt an upgrade for your current one, or to push forward quickly?

Find and Upgrade Weapons

New weapons can only be found in gun cabinets at the end of certain roads. Each cabinet offers a choice of three weapons — pick one, leave the rest. A weapon's rarity determines its stats and the number of affixes it can have. Affixes are random modifiers that directly boost the weapon or enhance your character's attributes. Higher-level roads offer more powerful guns, of higher rarity, and with stronger affixes.

Lose Your Gear, Not Your Experience

Death on the road will strip you of all resources and equipment, but it leaves all accumulated experience intact. Every surge of adrenaline and every zombie slain turns into XP that stays with your survivor forever. Invest it in your character's stats — these can never be taken away. Each new run begins with a weak weapon, but with a stronger, more experienced character.

Solo and Co-op Runs

Test the road alone, where the price of a mistake is ultimate. Or call a partner — two-player co-op offers a chance for salvation. Coordinate your actions, watch each other's backs, and plan your route together. The road will test if you can act in unison under the relentless press of the horde.

The road is calling. See you on the asphalt.

content_descriptors.notes: The content can be considered mature because the game's core mechanics revolve around killing enemies with guns. The art style is unrealistic, and the gore is stylized and unrealistic.
